# A transaction of nothing: 0.00 CAD on the receivable against 0.00 CAD in the
# bank. GnuCash's register saves one, and View → Lots offers its receivable
# split to any lot on that account, since the split is in none.
#
# What this fixture produces: one transaction, neither split in a lot.
2026-01-20 * "A line of nothing"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:Accounts Receivable 0.00 CAD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
		share_price: "1"
		value: "0.00"
	Assets:Bank 0.00 CAD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
		share_price: "1"
		value: "0.00"
